protocol.order: all five cells shuffled each round; seed 20261005
protocol.cache: warm; no eviction; fresh workspace and stage for every job
protocol.worker_timing: operation and correctness check; all seven workloads run in order per job
protocol.completion_timing: launch to process exit; preparation excluded
protocol.correctness: all workload checks, Run Bundle isolation, lower write absence and upper file count/size required

build_provenance.build: Both GNU/Linux release binaries were built from source.tar plus stdio-readiness.patch, in the same isolated source and target directories. Only crates/pvisor-overlay-core/src/core.rs was replaced between builds. The separately captured source.patch was not applied.
build_provenance.scope: Both include the same guest stdio readiness fix. Baseline core restores the resolver before unavailable-upper marker optimization; candidate core is the optimized resolver. Both use archived statx implementation.
